other_failure_modes.description: Rounding regression predictions to integers when the metric is RMSE introduces unnecessary error, as RMSE is mathematically minimized by the conditional mean (which is continuous), even if the true target is integer-valued.

summary: The agent provides a structurally sound and well-engineered baseline solution, properly avoiding data leakage by fitting transformers exclusively on the training split. However, it relies on a single validation split for a stochastic model and inappropriately rounds predictions to integers despite optimizing for RMSE, which mathematically biases the error metric upwards.
